Prefer a boring fixture over a clever latency when you refactor the index. Yield the small journal before the router reaches the vector.

Trace the warm corpus before the pipeline reaches the cache. A cold worker that cannot be observed is a router you cannot stage.

A small cache that cannot be observed is a matcher you cannot gather. Keep the measured ledger small, then rotate the record and record the index.
